description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for hiring a candidate within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends an abstract class, implements a method to get the resulting workflow state when a candidate is hired, and includes OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: CandidateHiringAPI
classes.description: API class for executing candidate hiring actions in the recruitment process.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state identifier corresponding to the 'hire' action for a candidate.
